prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Anka, the giant red bird guarding Mount Kaf. Native PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: One dog head, two eyes, a red-feathered bird body, two huge red wings and two tiger forelegs ending in large FURRY TIGER PAWS with feline toes and curved retractile tiger claws, NOT scaled bird legs or eagle talons; only one head. [anka-c02]
MOMENT: Rise from hot ash at the mountain summit with wings heaving upward and tiger claws reaching toward camera.
POWER: Rebirth from its own ashes: real embers and ash scatter from the nest beneath the rising bird, no magical ribbons. [anka-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; documented large being fills the frame, tiny environmental references show scale; distinguishing anatomy remains clear at 200 pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: Embers from the ash nest provide dominant warm rim light amid dark summit wind.
SURFACE: tactile natural fur, hair, feather, skin, cloth, scale or metal as appropriate to the documented form, never plastic.
SETTING: A summit nest on Mount Kaf. [anka-c03]
MOOD: reverent awe-inspiring presence, overwhelming and imposing; never cute, calm or decorative. Dark walnut, antique gold and parchment palette with one strong accent.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyph, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_requirements.description: One dog head, two eyes, a red-feathered bird body, two huge red wings and two tiger-clawed legs; only one head.
Rebirth from its own ashes: real embers and ash scatter from the nest beneath the rising bird, no magical ribbons.
A summit nest on Mount Kaf.

aura: Rise from hot ash at the mountain summit with wings heaving upward and tiger claws reaching toward camera. Supported by anka-c02, anka-c02, anka-c03.

artistic_choices.description: Low camera, dark warm palette, directional light and opaque clothing when applicable are editorial choices; no unrecorded powers.

rejected_attempts.reason: Feet rendered as scaled eagle talons, rather than the tiger claws of selected dog-headed tiger-clawed variant (anka-c02). Regenerate with furry tiger paws and retractile feline claws.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected. A single dog head rises above the red bird body, two red wings and two striped furry tiger legs with feline paw toes and claws. Ash, hot embers and summit nest visibly ground rebirth; no energy aura. Canine muzzle and hybrid paws are clear at 200px. First attempt rejected for bird talons, archived. Seven checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Dog-headed bird with red feathers, two huge red wings and tiger-striped clawed legs rising out of its burning nest in a shower of embers.
